observation_layout.sample_order: ascending image pixel y, then pixel x; img_000...; NOT hardware register order

mapping_assumptions.qualification: Left image direction confirmed by user; y-axis/view convention, 5 mm center-to-envelope margins and 8 mm nearest-site support radius are explicit simulation choices. Right foot is an unverified mirror. Pixel-to-meter scales fit x/y independently; no calibrated spacing or sensor transfer function claimed.

observation_layout.mount_assumption: Provisional metric embedding: left-image forefoot maps to H2 +x; image right maps to left-foot -y; right is mirrored. Center on source collision bounds, plane at collision bottom. Not the manual green origin or a measured hardware extrinsic.
observation_layout.identity: Image-derived sites, finite nearest-site force bins; not calibrated taxel response
observation_layout.axes: H2 foot-link x,y,z; not calibrated sensor axes

hardware_layout.outline: Point-shaped footprint from supplied image; physical active-area boundary remains unmeasured
hardware_layout.origin: Green point in section 2.3; numerical coordinates and axis directions not tabulated
hardware_layout.qualification: UI region IDs are not SPI module numbers. Exact mapping and boundaries are not assigned to virtual cells.
hardware_layout.left_image_source: User-confirmed left foot, top=forefoot; extracted visible point count

documented_registers.scope: Reference only; no SPI transport, CRC validation or hardware driver implemented
documented_registers.taxel_count_qualification: The table marks the 116th point addresses with asterisks and continues with ellipses; total/per-module point counts are not unambiguously specified.
documented_registers.qualification: The 0.1 N example is for resultant Fz only. Applying it to all uint8 Fz would cap at 25.5 N, which does not explain the 2000 N product range; no general scale or saturation is inferred.

scope: Offline image-point metric embedding; no Isaac, hardware, right-foot calibration or H2 Plus validation
